name: ismsa/fieldTypes/dataCategories

enumValues.enumDescription: Everyday personal data: names, identifiers, contact details, location data, online identifiers. Use 'Sensitive personal data' as well for the special categories.

Special categories of personal data under GDPR Article 9 — health, genetic and biometric data, racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, sex life and sexual orientation and criminal offence data under Article 10.
Passwords, API keys and shared secrets.
Private keys, symmetric keys, certificates and seeds, including the keys used to sign releases.
Session tokens, access tokens and refresh tokens.
Audit trails, event journals, alarm and event history. The recorded past.
How the asset is set up: parameters, policy and rules. Persistent, changed deliberately, usually by an administrator.
Setpoints, commands, recipes and actuation requests. Data that determines what the asset, or the equipment it drives, actually does.
The data the asset exists to handle: process values, measurements, live alarm state, transactions, orders, documents and records.
Update payloads, signed artefacts, build outputs and control programs.
Usage, diagnostic and crash data sent from an asset to whoever supplies or operates it. Not the data the asset handles on behalf of its users.
Data whose corruption or loss has health, safety or environmental consequences.

description: The categories of data that this asset stores, processes or transmits
